description: Use this to check many names at once (up to 500, or one name across every ending with tlds ["all"]): whether each is already registered, from DNS and public registry records, with its registrar and expiry date. It is a quick screen, not the registrar's answer: confirm the names you will suggest with search_domains.

details.description: Fetch the registry record for taken names too (registrar, dates). Default: on for up to 20 names.

name.description: A name without an ending, e.g. noren

tlds.description: Endings to try with name; ["all"] for every ending Nymwell sells; defaults to com, ai, dev, app, io, co, tw

name: screen_domains
title: Screen many domain names
